message:
# Task List

1. ⏳ Setup API and Analysis Functions
Implement the required callable API in /root/submission/tth-diphoton-bdt/analysis/top_categorization.py
2. ⏳ Implement Analysis Pipeline
Create the main pipeline script to execute the analysis from input to results
3. ⏳ Event Preselection and Channel Assignment
Implement photon and jet selection, hadronic/leptonic channel categorization
4. ⏳ BDT Training Data Preparation
Implement NTI continuum proxy construction, SM normalization, and class balancing
5. ⏳ BDT Training and Optimization
Train a deterministic binary classifier and implement the iterative boundary optimization
6. ⏳ Inference and Categorization
Run BDT inference and assign events to hadronic categories including the tH fallback cuts
7. ⏳ Categorization Normalization and Summary
Implement the 36 fb^-1 normalization and category yield summary
8. ⏳ Statistical Interpretation with RooFit
Implement ROOT/RooFit workspace construction and Asimov expected significance calculation
9. ⏳ Artifact Generation
Generate all required plots and JSON artifacts
10. ⏳ Final Reporting
Write the comprehensive report.md
